verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no documentation that n8n lets developers install community-built nodes or integrations. The closest items are adjacent and earn no credit: community-shared workflow templates (a different artifact), a community mention of custom node development and that 'new integrations can be built easily' (a developer building block), and npm packages inside code steps (a developer building block). None of these shows a mechanism for installing third-party-contributed nodes.

support.subject: As a developer, I can install community-built nodes, components, or integrations contributed outside the vendor
